text: Found-settlement refusal says 'Open ground lies about 200 to the north-west' but the HUD has no compass or map, so the player cannot tell which way north-west is. Tick ~124100.

Objective 6 'Build a market stall' bar shows 'Wood 20/20 • Stone 5/5' (full, gold) right after building a Farm, but inventory is Wood 5 / Stone 0. Progress looks cached from before the farm spent 25 wood + 10 stone. Expected 5/20 and 0/5. Also the objective text box runs underneath the Inventory panel.

Season panel still says 'Autumn - day 1/2' and 'Winter in 2 days' after timeOfDay went 0.30 -> 0.55 (a quarter day) since the world started; chronicle meanwhile shows 'Day 5'. Day numbering differs between Season panel (day 1/2), chronicle (Day 5) and state.json (day 4); the countdown never ticks down to e.g. 1.5 days, so a player cannot gauge how long until winter.

Game ran at 3-11 ticks/s (50 is full speed) and 1-2 fps the whole session (host load avg ~95 on 20 cores with parallel sessions). With --season autumn the HUD says 'Winter in 2 days' = 20 game minutes = 60000 ticks; at ~6 tps that is ~2.8 h wall, so the 'survive the first winter' goal cannot be reached in a 35 min session. In 22 wall minutes only ~7600 ticks (2.5 game min) passed.

Build confirm (K then K again) expired: pressed K, then K again ~8 s wall later (40 ticks at ~5 tps) and got 'Not confirmed in time, so nothing was done.' Twice. Only a ~1 s double-tap worked. At low frame rates the confirm window is very tight; a visible countdown or a click-to-confirm button would help. Ticks 127404-127532.

With a resident nearby inside the settlement the HUD reflows badly: the Inventory Info panel jumps to mid-screen over the world, Objective 7 progress bar text is cut off on the left ('nbers 2/10 • Buildings 1/2' instead of 'Members ...'), and the Season panel overlaps the Player Info title. Also Irene Taylor, who joined my nation, is offered as 'Talk to Irene Taylor (Stranger)'. Tick ~128632.
